## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior this change provides.

## Work item and commits

Link the tracking issue and milestone. Summarize the logical commits.

## Validation

Record commands and results for the current head. Distinguish local checks,
hosted CI, mock conformance, provider qualification and consumer acceptance.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe affected contracts, supported limits and the rollback path.
Identify any required design or release approval; tests do not grant approval.

## Public boundary

Use synthetic examples. Do not include credentials, request/response bodies,
private consumer identities, repository URLs, paths or operational records.
